mapper.select: select from knowledge_base where del_flag='0' and name like concat('%',#{name},'%') and status=#{status} order by id desc
select from knowledge_base where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
select count(*) from knowledge_base where name=#{name} and del_flag='0' and id != #{excludeId}
mapper.update: update knowledge_base set name=#{name},description=#{description},status=#{status},top_k=#{topK},similarity_threshold=#{similarityThreshold},max_context_chars=#{maxContextChars},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update knowledge_base set vector_collection=#{collection},update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update knowledge_base set del_flag='2',status='DISABLED',update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'

update knowledge_base b set document_count=(select count(*) from knowledge_document d where d.knowledge_base_id=b.id and d.del_flag='0'),chunk_count=(select count(*) from knowledge_chunk c join knowledge_document d on d.id=c.document_id and d.del_flag='0' and d.parse_status='SUCCESS' where c.knowledge_base_id=b.id and c.del_flag='0' and c.index_status='SUCCESS'),update_time=sysdate() where b.id=#{id} and b.del_flag='0'
update knowledge_base set embedding_model=#{model},update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from knowledge_document where del_flag='0' and knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} and parse_status=#{parseStatus} order by id desc
select * from knowledge_document where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
select count(*) from knowledge_document where knowledge_base_id=#{baseId} and project_file_id=#{projectFileId} and del_flag='0' and id != #{excludeId}
select count(*) from knowledge_document where project_file_id=#{projectFileId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update knowledge_document set parse_status='PARSING',error_message=null,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0' and parse_status in ('WAITING','FAILED','OCR_REQUIRED')

update knowledge_document set parse_status=#{parseStatus},chunk_count=#{chunkCount},char_count=#{charCount},embedding_model=#{embeddingModel},vector_collection=#{vectorCollection},error_message=#{errorMessage},indexed_time=#{indexedTime},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update knowledge_document set parse_status='WAITING',error_message=null,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0' and parse_status not in ('WAITING','PARSING')

update knowledge_document set parse_status='FAILED',error_message='处理进程中断或超时，请重新索引',update_by='system',update_time=sysdate() where knowledge_base_id=#{baseId} and del_flag='0' and parse_status in ('WAITING','PARSING') and coalesce(update_time,create_time) < date_sub(sysdate(),interval 60 minute)
update knowledge_document set del_flag='2',update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update knowledge_document set del_flag='2',update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where knowledge_base_id=#{baseId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select c.*,d.document_name from knowledge_chunk c join knowledge_document d on d.id=c.document_id and d.del_flag='0' where c.del_flag='0' and c.knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} and c.document_id=#{documentId} order by c.document_id,c.chunk_index
select c.*,d.document_name from knowledge_chunk c join knowledge_document d on d.id=c.document_id and d.del_flag='0' where c.document_id=#{documentId} and c.del_flag='0' order by c.chunk_index

select c.*,d.document_name from knowledge_chunk c join knowledge_document d on d.id=c.document_id and d.del_flag='0' and d.parse_status='SUCCESS' where c.knowledge_base_id=#{baseId} and c.index_status='SUCCESS' and c.del_flag='0' and c.id in #{id}
mapper.update: update knowledge_chunk set vector_id=cast(id as char),index_status='SUCCESS',update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where document_id=#{documentId} and del_flag='0'
update knowledge_chunk set index_status='FAILED',update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where document_id=#{documentId} and del_flag='0'
update knowledge_chunk set del_flag='2',update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where document_id=#{documentId} and del_flag='0'
update knowledge_chunk set del_flag='2',update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where knowledge_base_id=#{baseId} and del_flag='0'
